name: Hazael
bio: Hazael is first named at Horeb, where the LORD instructed Elijah to anoint him king over Syria (1 Kings 19:15) — one of three anointings Elijah was told to carry out, alongside Jehu as king over Israel and Elisha as prophet in his own place, together forming the LORD's instruments of judgment against the house of Ahab and against Baal worship in Israel (1 Kings 19:15-18). Hazael's rise to the throne of Syria and his long, violent conflict with Israel are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
